segment_text:
Split the following Chinese text into words. Return ONLY a JSON array of strings, one string per word, with no punctuation and no explanations.

Text: {text}
parse_pasted_text:
List every distinct word (excluding punctuation) in the following Chinese text. Return ONLY a JSON array of strings.

Text: {text}
generate_paragraph:
You are writing teaching material for an intermediate learner of Chinese at HSK level 4. Write ONE natural paragraph of 2-4 sentences in simplified Chinese for the topic '{topic_name}'.

Requirements:
- Use the word '{new_word}' exactly once — it is being introduced for the first time. This must be the only new word.
- Also use these previously introduced words at least once each: {repeat_words}
- Also use some of these review words if they fit naturally: {review_words}
- You may use simple common words (like 的, 是, 我, 你, 他, 很, 不) freely.
- Write ONLY Chinese characters. Do NOT use any Latin letters, English words, or acronyms (for example write 汉语水平考试, never HSK). Write numbers in Chinese characters (一二三), not digits.
- Every sentence must make sense on its own.
- Do not use any punctuation other than ，。？！
- Return only the Chinese paragraph, nothing else.
generate_paragraph_no_new:
You are writing teaching material for an intermediate learner of Chinese at HSK level 4. Write ONE natural paragraph of 2-4 sentences in simplified Chinese for the topic '{topic_name}'.

Requirements:
- This paragraph introduces NO new words. Do not mention new words, vocabulary, or the lesson itself in the text.
- Use these previously introduced words at least once each: {repeat_words}
- Also use some of these review words if they fit naturally: {review_words}
- You may use simple common words (like 的, 是, 我, 你, 他, 很, 不) freely.
- Write ONLY Chinese characters. Do NOT use any Latin letters, English words, or acronyms. Write numbers in Chinese characters (一二三), not digits.
- Every sentence must make sense on its own.
- Do not use any punctuation other than ，。？！
- Return only the Chinese paragraph, nothing else.
generate_sentence:
You are writing teaching material for an intermediate learner of Chinese at HSK level 4. Write ONE natural sentence in simplified Chinese for the topic '{topic_name}'.

Requirements:
- Use the word '{new_word}' exactly once — it is being introduced for the first time. This must be the only new word.
- Also use these words if they fit naturally: {repeat_words} {review_words}
- Write ONLY Chinese characters. Do NOT use any Latin letters, English words, or acronyms. Write numbers in Chinese characters (一二三), not digits.
- Do not use any punctuation other than ，。？！
- Return only the Chinese sentence, nothing else.
generate_final_paragraph:
You are writing the final paragraph of a Chinese lesson for an intermediate learner at HSK level 4. Write ONE paragraph of 3-5 sentences in simplified Chinese that uses ALL of the following words at least once: {all_new_words}

Rules:
- Do NOT introduce any new vocabulary.
- Every word must already be familiar: {all_new_words} plus common simple words.
- Write ONLY Chinese characters. Do NOT use any Latin letters, English words, or acronyms. Write numbers in Chinese characters (一二三), not digits.
- Every sentence must make sense on its own.
- Return only the Chinese paragraph, nothing else.
translate_word: For the Chinese word '{word}', return ONLY a JSON object with keys 'pinyin' (pinyin with tone marks) and 'definition' (a short English definition).
translate_sentence:
Translate the following Chinese sentence into natural English. Return ONLY the translation.

Sentence: {sentence}
